Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: O03.6.3
Parent: O03.6 (bd-01M4XPCN6RSRCS8CB96BR5Y8GY)
Plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Scope: Implementation slice of O03.6; parent acceptance is unchanged. Qualify integrated witness/catalog failures and recovery fencing.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Run real separately permissioned stores and separate primary/witness processes through every PREPARE/local-commit/remote-COMMIT/local-receipt boundary, including lost responses, restart and durable exact retries; prove already-local restrictions and absence of false success or overtaking.
2. Qualify complete fenced enrollment from preexisting restrictive authority and unchanged legacy history; an empty witness, stale primary, unknown capability, altered trust, foreign installation, gap, reordered record or tampered payload must fail closed.
3. Advance a durable recovery barrier with a fresh challenge, prove independent old-writer fencing and permit/drain limits, and verify lost primary with unresolved PREPARE keeps recovery closed. Do not infer computer/disk survival from same-host fixtures.
4. Build the current installable artifact and run appropriate service/runtime-role, historical-upgrade and authority regression checks. Bind source, artifact, protected configuration identities and observed fault-matrix outcomes in receipts, without retaining secrets.
5. Review every unchanged parent O03.6 acceptance criterion against observed evidence. Close neither the parent nor downstream restore gates if any criterion is failed or not run; preserve O03.2 full identity/session and O03.3/SITE01 institutional obligations.

Evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.6.3/receipt.json
Completion: every criterion requires observed evidence; planning closes no work. Parent and organization recovery remain open until integrated qualification.
